title: thermite-skill: dynamic surface inventory (exhaustive-match + registry-driven) to kill skill staleness
description: The THERMITE.skill.md generator's surface-inventory sections (render_grammar/render_forge/render_ladder/render_slag in thermite-skill/src/generate.rs) are CURATED STATIC STRINGS and have drifted: the committed skill claims 'no struct/enum' while thermite-syntax ships Item::Struct/Item::Enum/Type::Vec/Type::String/Expr::StrLit/Expr::Is/Expr::StructLit/Expr::Deref and thermite_spec::schemes (fold/map/for_all/exists/traverse) -- none appear in the skill. Per .design/skill/skill-generator.md REQ-8..REQ-11 (this amendment): make the surface inventory DYNAMIC -- registry-driven for the recursion schemes (thermite_spec::schemes::all(), mirroring render_combinators over thermite_spec::all()) and EXHAUSTIVE-MATCH-driven (no _ wildcard) over the definitional enums thermite_syntax::Type/Expr/Item/Pattern/Effect, so a new variant FAILS TO COMPILE until its skill arm lands. Keep the explanatory prose (thesis/ladder/slag narrative) curated + freshness-tested. Hold the 6k budget + the committed==generate() freshness test. forge Command enum is private + forge depends on thermite-skill (reverse dep) so the forge command list stays a freshness-tested curated table (doc REQ-11 honesty note / OQ-5).
